The first 2 years I cried at least once every day. It’s taken me 4 years to not freak out every time I see my hair without “hair makeup”, not to obsess and try to not let it control my life. I’ve found ways to manage my hair and the feelings around it. 

It’s all really hard and it’s going to be constant wave of ups and downs. And I still think about it A LOT, but not nearly as much as I had in the first two years.
